gen-dafont-starborn-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans sits sturdy and large, its e opening clearly to the right. What stands out is how Starborn drifts, with wide gaps between letters and a dark stripe of lowercase, over that grounded sans-serif body.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-merriweather-sans: Gaping mouths on every e give Visitor a nostalgic, digital look, with strokes pulled like solder. But Merriweather Sans holds firm underneath, its words sturdy and large, with an e that opens clearly to the right.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-hanuman: Chain-link tight: New Title locks its letters together like links in a fine chain. And where New Title delivers punch, Hanuman delivers refinement through a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set s terminals.
gen-gf-grandstander-general-sans: General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure from first letter to last, with an x-height that fills the line. General Sans backs up Grandstander, whose bold, expressive lines stay constant-width while its letters are held open.
gen-gf-gugi-manrope: In Gugi, lowercase letters nearly reach the capitals, with terminals cut open so counters flow outward. But Manrope leaves a bright open gap at every curve, and its line holds one width throughout.
gen-gf-paprika-fs-public-sans: Scattered and commanding, Paprika fills the line with lowercase that behaves like capitals. Public Sans holds its ground beneath, trustworthy, with a hefty lowercase and broad, open counters on c and s.
gen-dafont-azonix-fs-supreme: Thin plastic tubing bent into loops: that is Azonix, wide-mouthed letters staying crisp when shrunk. And Supreme lays a thick, heavy-looking strip of text beneath, its letters held open rather than curled shut.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-fs-epilogue: Expressive is the right word for Snowburst One, a stencil sheet with wide bridges between letters. Epilogue, with its wire-like monoline skeleton and curvy, unclamped letters, gives that stencil a relaxed counterpart.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-fs-public-sans: Commanding in a marker-like way, Tilt Neon draws a constant-width tube of line with a splayed c terminal. Tilt Neon supplies the punch; Public Sans supplies trustworthy, hefty body text.
gen-gf-unica-one-general-sans: Visible daylight inside every curve and a very large lowercase eye give Unica One its commanding look. General Sans follows with steady pen pressure and a smooth path around each bend.
